Thanks — reviewing now. I made editorial suggestions and a recommended final set below. I attached the hero_variants.docx with inline comments.

My recommended hero + CTA (concise & field-friendly):

Hero (short): "Predictable, low-latency LLM inference for production apps"
Subhead (optional): "SLA-backed inference, intelligent batching, and configurable private deployments"
Button (primary): "Start 30‑day trial"
Button (alt): "Request a demo"

Why this works: 
- Focuses the field on key buyer priorities (latency, predictability, deployment options).
- CTA "Start 30‑day trial" sets expectation for trial availability on PrivateOffer SKUs where enabled.

Entitlement footnote (one-liner for product page):
"Trial entitlements vary by SKU and region. PrivateOffer (reserved) SKUs may require field-enabled trials — contact your AWS seller for provisioning."

SKU / PrivateOffer guidance (from Acme assets):
- acme-rr-inference-standard — public metered (no trial)
- acme-rr-inference-dedicated — privateoffer (trial available upon field enablement)
- acme-rr-ami — AMI listing (region parity note required)

Procurement note for sellers (2 lines):
"Recommend offering a 30‑day PrivateOffer trial for dedicted customers; usage metering remains per-hour for metered SKUs. For AMI deployments, confirm regional AMI visibility prior to demo."

Co-sell enablement script (short):
- Elevator: "Redwood Inference delivers predictable LLM inference at scale — low latency, dedicated and private options, and cost controls to fit enterprise needs."
- Objection response (pricing): "We recommend a privateoffer trial to validate TCO; typical customers see 20–40% cost reduction via batching/quantization optimizations."
- Next step: "Open a PrivateOffer case and provision a 30‑day trial; Redwood will provide a field playbook and sample prompts."

I attached hero_variants.docx and will add a short co-sell-play script (co-sell-script.md) with two sample 30s pitches for sellers.

Let me know if you want the hero text shortened further for the tile. If we're happy I'll push copy to the staging page and flag the HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.company.com/deal/12345

—Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Marketplace Product Marketing, Redwood Inference
